overview: Liberal Arts careers in India suffer from the 'but what jobs are there?' framing — yet ASI, National Museum, ICHR, ICSSR, Sahitya Akademi, Lalit Kala Akademi, IIAS Shimla, NCERT, NIEPA, foreign service, journalism, foundations, NGOs, and the academic/research ecosystem absorb tens of thousands of humanities graduates yearly. The 2026 reality: BA students at top central universities (DU, JNU, BHU, Hyderabad Central, JMI) pay near-zero tuition (₹500-30,000 total programme cost) and have direct access to ASI's PG Diploma in Archaeology, IIPA Public Admin, and IIFT trade-policy programmes. UGC NET-JRF gives ₹37-42K/month stipend through PhD; INSPIRE Faculty Award gives ₹35K + ₹35L research grant for 5 years post-PhD. Niche fields like Anthropology (very high UPSC optional success rate), Archival Science (NAI training), and Cognitive Science (IIIT Hyderabad, IIT Gandhinagar) are strong but invisible to most 12th-graders.
key_insights: Anthropology is one of the highest-success-rate UPSC CSE optionals — many top-rankers in the last decade chose it; the BA/MA pathway thus doubles as IAS prep.
Archival Science via NAI's School of Archival Studies leads to permanent govt archivist posts (Pay Level 7-10) at NAI, state archives, defence archives — a stable career almost no 12th-grader knows.
ASI's 2-year PG Diploma in Archaeology (Institute of Archaeology, Delhi) is the gold standard for ASI Assistant Archaeologist recruitment — only ~25 seats annually.
IIPA New Delhi runs a 1-year Advanced PG Diploma in Public Admin used by IAS aspirants and central-govt mid-career officers; it's a credible policy pathway.
Cognitive Science at IIIT Hyderabad's CCS, IIT Gandhinagar Cognitive Science Programme, NIMHANS Bangalore opens up rapidly-growing AI-adjacent humanities career paths.

sub_paths.name: Archaeology (BA / MA / ASI PG Diploma)
sub_paths.description: Study of past human societies through artifacts, excavation, conservation. Direct path to ASI, state archaeology depts, museum sector.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: 45-50% for BA Hons at top central universities; CUET-UG cutoff dominant
sub_paths.entry_route: Degree → Govt exam (UPSC/SSC for ASI) / PG Diploma
sub_paths.qualification: BA + MA (Archaeology / AIH&CA) + ASI PG Diploma in Archaeology
sub_paths.duration: BA 3 yrs + MA 2 yrs + ASI Diploma 2 yrs
sub_paths.entrance_exam: CUET-UG/PG, ASI Institute of Archaeology entrance, UPSC for ASI Asst Archaeologist
sub_paths.govt_fees: BHU/DU/Calcutta Univ 1,000-30,000 total; ASI Institute of Archaeology Delhi nearly free
top_institutions: Institute of Archaeology - ASI New Delhi (govt)
Delhi Institute of Heritage Research and Management (semi-govt)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: MA/PhD at Cambridge, Oxford, UCL Institute of Archaeology, Heidelberg, Penn, Toronto. Strong foreign archaeology funding for South Asia specialists.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Site excavation seasons (Oct-Mar typically), lab work on artifacts, museum cataloguing, reports/publications. Long stretches of fieldwork at remote sites.
sub_paths.growth_path: Asst Archaeologist (ASI Pay Level 7) → Dy Superintending Archaeologist → Superintending → Director → DG ASI. State archaeology, UNESCO consultancy alternatives.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 4.5-7 LPA (ASI/state) / Mid: 8-15 LPA / Senior (Director): 18-30 LPA. Note: ASI Asst Archaeologist Pay Level 7/8; international consultants (UNESCO) 20+ LPA. Source: ASI recruitment, indcareer.

sub_paths.name: Linguistics (BA / MA / PhD Research)
sub_paths.description: Scientific study of language structure, sociolinguistics, computational linguistics, language documentation. Strong AI/NLP industry crossover.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: 45-50% for BA Hons; CUET cutoff dominant
sub_paths.duration: BA 3 yrs (where offered) + MA 2 yrs + PhD 4-6 yrs
top_institutions: University of Hyderabad School of Humanities (govt)
Indian Institute of Information Technology Hyderabad CCS (semi-govt, computational)
CIIL Mysore (govt, Central Institute of Indian Languages)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: PhD at MIT, Stanford, Harvard, Cambridge, UCL, Edinburgh — top-funded for theoretical/computational linguistics. ELDP for endangered language documentation.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Field research recording speakers, corpus building, theoretical/syntax work, NLP applications at language-tech firms. Mix of academic and industry routes.
sub_paths.growth_path: Researcher → Asst Prof → Asso Prof / pivot to NLP industry (Google, Microsoft, ML startups). NLP industry roles 15-50 LPA at MAANG India.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher (academic): 4-8 LPA / Mid (academic): 10-25 LPA / NLP industry: 12-50 LPA. Note: UGC Asst Prof ₹57,700 entry; Google India Linguist 18-35L. Source: UGC pay, AmbitionBox.

sub_paths.name: Anthropology (Social / Cultural / Physical / Archaeological)
sub_paths.description: Study of human societies and cultures past and present. Strong UPSC optional, NGO/development sector pathway.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: 45-50% for BA Hons; CUET cutoff dominant
sub_paths.duration: BA 3 yrs + MA 2 yrs + PhD 4-6 yrs
top_institutions: Indira Gandhi National Tribal University Amarkantak (govt)
scholarships: Anthropological Survey of India research grants
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: MA/PhD at Harvard, Chicago, LSE, SOAS, EHESS Paris, ANU. Strong development-sector pathway via UN agencies, World Bank.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Ethnographic field work in communities, interviews, archival research, policy reports. Mix of remote field stays and urban write-up time.
sub_paths.growth_path: Researcher → Asst Prof / Development Sector / Policy Analyst. UPSC CSE Anthro optional historically high success rate; many move into IAS.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher (academic/NGO): 3.5-7 LPA / Mid: 8-18 LPA / Senior: 18-40 LPA. Note: Anthropological Survey scientist ₹56,100+ entry; NGOs (PRADAN, Pratham) 5-10L; UN/World Bank consultants 20+ LPA. Source: UGC, NCS.

sub_paths.name: Museum Studies / Curatorship
sub_paths.description: Curatorial work, exhibition design, collection management at govt and private museums, art galleries, heritage sites.
sub_paths.qualification: MA in History/Art History/Archaeology + PG Diploma in Museology (NMI, Baroda)
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NMI New Delhi entrance, MS University Baroda entrance, CUET-PG
sub_paths.private_fees: Limited; private heritage management programmes 1-3 lakh
top_institutions: Salar Jung Museum Hyderabad - heritage training (govt)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: MA in Museum Studies at UCL, NYU, Leicester, Toronto. Strong UNESCO heritage management pathway; Smithsonian fellowships.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Collection cataloguing, exhibition curation, conservation oversight, public programs, scholarship & publication. Mix of indoor museum work and field site visits.
sub_paths.growth_path: Asst Curator → Curator → Senior Curator → Director. National Museum, IGNCA, state museums; private galleries (Devi Art, Saffronart, Gallery Espace).
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 4-7 LPA / Mid: 7-15 LPA / Senior: 15-35 LPA. Note: National Museum curator Pay Level 10-11; private galleries variable; international heritage consultancy (UNESCO) 20+ LPA. Source: NMI, indcareer.

sub_paths.name: Archival Science
sub_paths.description: Manage and conserve govt records, historical archives, defence archives at NAI and state archives. Stable govt career path.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: Indirect; need MA + diploma for archivist roles
sub_paths.qualification: MA in History + 1-yr Diploma in Archives & Records Management (NAI School of Archival Studies)
sub_paths.entrance_exam: NAI School of Archival Studies entrance
sub_paths.govt_fees: NAI Diploma nearly free + stipend; Calcutta Univ archives MA 5,000-30,000
top_institutions: National Archives of India (NAI) School of Archival Studies Delhi (govt)
scholarships: NAI School of Archival Studies stipend
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: MA Archives at UCL, Liverpool, Michigan iSchool, UBC. ICA training programmes for archivists internationally.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Cataloguing, descriptive listing, conservation oversight, researcher reference work, digitisation projects. Quiet, detail-oriented indoor work.
sub_paths.growth_path: Asst Archivist → Archivist → Senior Archivist → Director. NAI, state archives, defence (INHO Mumbai, AHQ records), corporate archives (Tata, Godrej).
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 4.5-8 LPA / Mid: 8-15 LPA / Senior: 15-30 LPA. Note: NAI Asst Archivist Pay Level 7-8; Tata Central Archives Pune / Godrej Archives 6-12L. Source: NAI, 7th Pay.

sub_paths.name: Philosophy (BA / MA / PhD)
sub_paths.description: Study of logic, ethics, metaphysics, Indian philosophy, applied philosophy (medical/business ethics). Academic + emerging policy roles.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: 45-50% for BA Hons; CUET cutoff dominant
sub_paths.duration: BA 3 yrs + MA 2 yrs + PhD 4-6 yrs
sub_paths.entrance_exam: CUET-UG/PG, JNU/DU/JMI entrance, IIT-JAM (Humanities & Social Sciences for some IITs)
top_institutions: Indian Institute of Advanced Study Shimla (govt, fellowships)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: PhD at Oxford, Cambridge, MIT, Princeton, Pittsburgh, Harvard. Indian philosophy programmes at SOAS, Hawaii, Heidelberg also strong.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Reading, writing, seminars, teaching. Academic career heavy on publication and conferences; applied roles in medical ethics committees, AI ethics.
sub_paths.growth_path: Researcher → Asst Prof → Asso Prof → Prof. Emerging non-academic roles: AI ethics at tech firms, bioethics committees, policy think tanks.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 3.5-7 LPA / Mid: 9-20 LPA / Senior: 18-40 LPA. Note: UGC Asst Prof ₹57,700; AI ethics roles at tech firms (Google, Microsoft) 12-30L; Ashoka/Krea private uni faculty similar. Source: UGC pay, AmbitionBox.

sub_paths.name: Cognitive Science (Interdisciplinary)
sub_paths.description: Mind, brain, AI, language interface — combines psychology, linguistics, neuroscience, philosophy, computer science.
sub_paths.qualification: BSc / MS Cognitive Science / MS by Research / PhD
sub_paths.duration: BSc/BA 3 yrs + MS 2 yrs + PhD 4-6 yrs
sub_paths.entrance_exam: IIIT-H PGEE, IIT Gandhinagar entrance, JNU CCMC, NIMHANS entrance
sub_paths.govt_fees: IIIT-H / IIT Gandhinagar / JNU 50,000-3 lakh total
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: MS/PhD at MIT BCS, Stanford Symbolic Systems, CMU Cognitive Science, Edinburgh Informatics. Heavy NLP/AI industry crossover.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Lab experiments (psychology/neuroscience), computational modelling (Python/R/MATLAB), interdisciplinary collaboration. Strong industry pathway to AI research labs.
sub_paths.growth_path: Researcher → Asst Prof / AI/NLP industry. Industry exit at MAANG India 15-40 LPA; research scientist at OpenAI/DeepMind type roles 1-3 Cr abroad.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher (industry): 8-18 LPA / Mid: 15-40 LPA / Senior: 30-1.5 Cr. Note: India AI research roles emerging fast; PhD-track salaries via UGC pay; industry pay much higher. Source: AmbitionBox, IIIT-H placement reports.

sub_paths.name: History (BA / MA / PhD)
sub_paths.description: Study of past, archives, public history, museum work, journalism. Mainstream BA route with multiple non-teaching exits.
sub_paths.duration: BA 3 yrs + MA 2 yrs + PhD 4-6 yrs
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: MA/PhD at Cambridge, Oxford, Yale, Chicago, SOAS, Sciences Po. South Asian History strong pathway with funded positions.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Archival research, reading, writing, teaching, conferences. Academic career heavy; public history (museums, publishing, documentary) alternatives.
sub_paths.growth_path: Researcher → Asst Prof → Asso Prof → Prof. UPSC CSE History optional widely chosen; civil services route active.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 3.5-7 LPA / Mid: 9-18 LPA / Senior: 18-40 LPA. Note: UGC Asst Prof ₹57,700; private uni faculty 12-22L; publishing/documentary 6-15L. Source: UGC pay, AmbitionBox.

sub_paths.name: Geography (BA / MA / GIS)
sub_paths.description: Physical and human geography + GIS / remote sensing crossover into urban planning, climate, environmental consultancy.
sub_paths.duration: BA 3 yrs + MA 2 yrs + GIS cert 6 mo-1 yr
sub_paths.private_fees: Symbiosis 2-4 lakh; GIS at IIRS/CSC 50,000-2 lakh
top_institutions: Indian Institute of Remote Sensing Dehradun (govt, GIS)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: MA/PhD at Cambridge, UCL, ETH Zurich, Penn State. Strong climate-policy and urban-planning international pathway.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Field surveys, GIS mapping at workstation, urban planning analysis, environmental impact assessment. Mix of indoor/outdoor.
sub_paths.growth_path: Researcher → Asst Prof / GIS Analyst / Urban Planner. ISRO/IIRS GIS scientist; private GIS consultants; UPSC CSE Geography optional very popular.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 3.5-7 LPA / Mid: 8-15 LPA / Senior: 15-30 LPA. Note: ISRO scientist ₹56,100+; private GIS consultants (RMSI, Esri India) 6-15L; urban planners (HUDCO, NHAI) 6-12L. Source: AmbitionBox, ISRO.

sub_paths.name: Political Science / Public Policy
sub_paths.description: Govt, IR, public policy analysis. Strong UPSC route; also think tank, NGO, journalism, electoral consulting careers.
sub_paths.qualification: BA Pol Sci / MA Pol Sci / MA Public Policy
sub_paths.entrance_exam: CUET-UG/PG, JNU entrance, IIPA entrance, NLSIU/Hyderabad MPP
sub_paths.govt_fees: DU/JNU/JMI 500-30,000; IIPA Advanced PG Diploma 1-2 lakh
top_institutions: JNU - Centre for Pol Studies / SIS (govt)
Indian Institute of Public Administration Delhi (govt)
Tata Inst of Social Sciences MA Pub Policy (govt)
Ashoka University Trivedi Centre for Political Data (private)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: MPP/MPA at Harvard Kennedy, Oxford BSG, Sciences Po, LKY Singapore. Strong World Bank/UN/foundation pathway.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Research papers, policy briefs, campaign strategy (election consulting), think tank work, journalism. Mix of academia + policy + public sector.
sub_paths.growth_path: Research Associate → Senior Researcher → Policy Lead → Director / Diplomat (UPSC IFS) / Politician's advisor. Election strategy consultancies (I-PAC, Nation with NaMo) hire Pol Sci heavily.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 4-9 LPA / Mid: 9-20 LPA / Senior: 18-45 LPA. Note: Think tanks (CPR, ORF) 6-12L; election consulting 8-25L; international orgs (UN/WB) 20+ LPA. Source: AmbitionBox, think-tank disclosures.

sub_paths.name: Sociology (BA / MA / PhD)
sub_paths.description: Study of social structures, inequality, urban/rural sociology. Strong NGO, development sector, research, UPSC optional pathway.
sub_paths.duration: BA 3 yrs + MA 2 yrs + PhD 4-6 yrs
top_institutions: JNU Centre for the Study of Social Systems (govt)
TISS Mumbai School of Social Sciences (govt)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: PhD at LSE, Oxford, Chicago, Berkeley, EHESS Paris. Strong development-sector route via World Bank, UNICEF, ILO.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Field research, surveys, qualitative interviews, policy reports. NGO/development work very field-heavy; academia heavier on writing.
sub_paths.growth_path: Research Associate → Senior Researcher → Asst Prof. Strong NGO/foundation pathway (PRADAN, Pratham, J-PAL, Azim Premji Foundation) at 6-15 LPA mid-career.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 3.5-7 LPA / Mid: 8-18 LPA / Senior: 15-40 LPA. Note: NGO sector 5-10L; J-PAL/IFMR 8-15L; UN consultants 20+ LPA. Source: AmbitionBox, NCS.

sub_paths.name: International Relations / Area Studies
sub_paths.description: Specialized study of regions (East Asia, West Asia, Latin America, Europe) + diplomatic studies. Direct foreign-service prep + think tank / journalism.
sub_paths.qualification: BA Pol Sci / MA International Relations / Area Studies
sub_paths.duration: BA 3 yrs + MA 2 yrs + PhD 4-6 yrs
sub_paths.entrance_exam: CUET-UG/PG, JNU SIS entrance, JMI entrance
top_institutions: Jamia Millia Islamia - MMAJ Academy of Int'l Studies (govt)
Indian Institute of Foreign Trade Delhi (govt, MA in International Trade)
OP Jindal School of International Affairs (private)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: MA at LSE IR, Sciences Po PSIA, SOAS, Johns Hopkins SAIS, Georgetown SFS, Tufts Fletcher.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Research, regional analysis, op-eds, think-tank events, embassy support roles. Heavy foreign-language requirement for serious area studies.
sub_paths.growth_path: Research Associate → Senior → Director (think tank) / Diplomat (UPSC IFS) / Foreign-policy journalist. Foreign embassies / multilateral postings as senior career.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 4-9 LPA / Mid: 10-22 LPA / Senior: 20-50 LPA. Note: Think tanks (ORF, CPR, IDSA) 6-12L; ICRIER/IIFT 8-15L; UN-system roles 20+ LPA. Source: think tank disclosures, AmbitionBox.

sub_paths.name: Peace & Conflict Studies / Development Studies
sub_paths.description: Specialized study of conflict resolution, post-conflict reconstruction, development economics, human rights, NGO sector preparation.
sub_paths.qualification: BA + MA Peace Studies / MA Development Studies / MPhil
sub_paths.entrance_exam: CUET-PG, JMI entrance, TISS NET, NIAS Bangalore
sub_paths.private_fees: Tata Inst of Social Sciences 70,000-1.5 lakh; Azim Premji Univ 4-8 lakh; Ashoka 6-15 lakh
top_institutions: TISS Mumbai - School of Development Studies (govt)
Jamia Millia Islamia - Nelson Mandela Centre for Peace (govt)
Azim Premji University Bangalore (private, dev studies)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: MA at Notre Dame Kroc, Bradford, Uppsala, Geneva IHEID. UN agency internships are standard pathway.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Field research in conflict-affected areas, evaluation of NGO programmes, policy briefs, advocacy. Heavy travel; emotionally demanding work.
sub_paths.growth_path: Programme Associate → Senior → Programme Director (NGO) / UN Officer / Academic. Strong UN pathway via JPO programmes.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 4-8 LPA / Mid: 8-18 LPA / Senior: 18-45 LPA. Note: NGO sector (PRADAN, Pratham, J-PAL) 5-12L; UN/multilateral 18-50 LPA; development consultancies 8-20L. Source: TISS placement, NCS.

data_confidence_notes: Central university tuition (DU, JNU, BHU, JMI) verified at near-zero levels for 2026 academic year via collegedunia and university websites.
ASI Asst Archaeologist pay (₹4.5-7 LPA, Pay Level 7-8) verified via indcareer and 7th Pay Commission scales.
UGC NET-JRF stipend ₹37-42K/month, INSPIRE Faculty ₹35K + ₹35L grant verified from UGC and DST notifications.
Archival Science confidence 'low' — practitioner pool is small and salary disclosures sparse outside the 7th Pay Commission scale.
Cognitive Science confidence 'medium' — emerging interdisciplinary field; salary trajectory depends heavily on whether graduate goes academic vs AI/NLP industry.
Sociology, Anthropology, History pay reflects UGC Asst Prof scale + NGO/development variation; range is wide but data well-documented.
